messages:
alex: quick sync — i'm putting together a focused dashboard to debug continuous-batching heuristics. primary goal: make it easy to spot when kernel selection + kv-cache behavior is causing poor batch utilization or token/sec regressions. thoughts?

maria: love it. can you list the core panels you want? also need per-model splits.

alex: yes. initial panels i have in mind — short list: batch_utilization (tokens_in_batch / max_tokens), queue_depth (pending requests), tokens_per_sec (system & per-model), batch_size_histogram, batch_latency_p99, kv_cache_hit_rate(by prefix_len), kernel_selector_count(by kernel), tail_samples (sampled traces for long tails).

kevin: add: active_token_budget vs target_token_budget (rolling 1m/5m), and a per-route sample rate. also we should surface 'queue_reason' tag (e.g., small-input, kv-miss, long-context) so ops can filter.

jasper: note: kv-cache churn is the sneaky one — seq length distribution + cache invalidation ends up creating tiny batches. metric we started collecting helps: kv_cache_evictions_total and kv_cache_prefix_hit_len_avg. surface those.

alex: good call. i want an encoded drilldown: top row is global KPIs (tokens/sec, avg batch_utilization, p99 latency), middle row model-by-model heatmap, bottom row alerting & tail traces.

infra-bot: deploy scheduled: grafana/dashboard/kv-batching-proto -> staging at 2026-03-18T10:00Z :rocket:

observability-bot: prototype dashboard posted: https://grafana.internal/g/kv-batching-proto — panels include PromQL samples and a link to trace sampler.

kevin: sample queries i'm proposing (untested):
```
# tokens/sec overall
sum(rate(tokens_processed_total[1m]))

# avg batch utilization per model
avg by (model) (rate(tokens_in_batch_total[1m]) / rate(max_tokens_capacity[1m]))

# p99 batch latency
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(batch_latency_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, model))
```

maria: for alerts: what thresholds? e.g., if avg batch_utilization drops below 30% for >5m AND tokens/sec drops 20% -> page? we need to avoid noisy pages.

jasper: agree. suggest phased alerting: first page to eng-runtime@ on persistent regressions (>15m) or >30% drop for high-traffic models. otherwise post to channel with :eyes:. also a regression detector using weekly baseline helps (z-score).

alex: actionable items: 1) kevin — add token_budget panels + query refinements (ETA EOD). 2) jasper — expose kv evictions & prefix metrics (ETA tomorrow AM). 3) maria — draft alert rules (inc. staging quiet rules) (ETA tomorrow). 4) i'll wire up the heatmap + trace links and validate with two recent perf regressions. @kevin @jasper @maria please ack. :thumbsup:

kevin: ack. will include queue_reason dimension.

maria: ack. i'll do noise budget and runbook notes.

jasper: ack — i'll instrument a cheap sample (1/100) of request payloads for tail analysis and add a metric for consecutive-kv-miss streaks.

alex: one more: include a small panel showing kernel_selection distribution (counts by kernel_type) — that's saved us before when a bad kernel rolled out.

kevin: +1. and add an annotation stream for deploy tags so we can correlate rollouts with utilization drops.

infra-bot: annotation added for deploy: release/2026-03-18/kernels-v2

alex: perfect. i'll validate in staging after infra deploy. if people see odd signals once live, drop samples here and i'll pull traces. :eyes:

maria: thanks — this will make debugging continuous-batching regressions way faster.

kevin: quick note — for long-term storage we should compress batch_histogram to 1h rollups after 7d. prevents metric explosion.

jasper: agreed — also add a small job to export low-sample tails to s3 for offline analysis.

alex: cool. closing loop: will follow-up with dashboard PR once queries are hardened.

observability-bot: dashboard PR created: https://git.internal/repo/grafana/dashboards/pull/42 :white_check_mark:
